title: Where Food Comes From, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Where Food Comes From, Inc. (WFCF) filed a Form 8-K on April 10, 2026, reporting results from its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held on April 9, 2026. All six director nominees were elected with overwhelming support, the appointment of Haynie & Company as independent auditor was ratified, executive compensation was approved by advisory vote, and stockholders voted for a triennial frequency for future say-on-pay votes.
key_points: Company: Where Food Comes From, Inc. (NASDAQ: WFCF), a Castle Rock, Colorado-based food verification company
Six directors elected: John Saunders, Leann Saunders, Peter C. Lapaseotes Jr., Adam Larson, Tom Heinen, and Graeme P. Rein—all with >99% support
Auditor ratification: Haynie & Company approved (4,405,870 For / 12,024 Against / 14,435 Abstain)
Executive compensation advisory vote: Approved with 3,861,757 For / 5,037 Against / 35,224 Abstain
Say-on-pay frequency vote: Stockholders recommended triennial votes (3,412,172 votes for 3 years)
